svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Flower wrapping: seamless repeat tile 140 x 140 mm
svg.desc: Seamless repeat. Champagne botanical pattern on ivory. Large areas: print CMYK gold or metallic ink, not foil. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.

g.inkscape:label: CMYK PRINT - IVORY BACKGROUND (omit when printing on ivory stock)
CHAMPAGNE BOTANICAL PATTERN - CMYK GOLD or METALLIC INK (not foil)
